title: Dependent Groups
description: An appointment picker where a RadioGroup of day cards drives a separate RadioGroup of times, each laid out in a RadioCardGrid, and a new day clears the picked time. Full days and booked times are disabled and say so in Badge elements in a RadioCardSlot with $kind="box" and $floating, the description prop of the times group adds a time zone hint under its label, and each grid takes $gap="xl" for the badges, with $gap="lg" on each group to keep its label further from the cards. Use it when the options of one group depend on the value of another.
